item.title: Former driver sues Seminole Feed alleging discrimination after workplace injury
item.description: A former driver for a prominent Ocala-based horse feed manufacturer has filed an employment discrimination lawsuit against the company, alleging he was fired after injuring his shoulder on the job and subsequently denied the opportunity to return to work on light duty.
